f4baee1d: Exit point.

368a604f: Process 'INCOMPLETE' status:
Calculate delay based on dictation date vs. current date.
Set flag if delay exceeds parameter.
Call DAYS and TOT1 to update counters if flag set.

20b4aa95: Process 'DICTATED' status:
Set flag.
Call DAYS and TOT1 to update counters.

4d735e7f: Process 'TRANSCRIBED' status:
Calculate delay based on transcription date vs. transcription parameter.
Set flag if delay exceeds parameter.
Call DAYS and TOT1 to update counters if flag set.

052ce069: Process 'SIGNED' status:
Calculate delay based on signature date vs. signature parameter.
Set flag if delay exceeds parameter.
Call DAYS and TOT1 to update counters if flag set.
96626cb7: Exit point for PROC.
a53db662: Calculate delay in days between two dates and store in DGJTDL.

d1ecaa78: Set start date for counting total time:
Use earliest of 'not available', 'DICTATED DATE', or current date.
Call FileMan %DTC to calculate elapsed time.

93dfb691: If no dictation date but signature date exists:
Set DGJT2PC and DGJT3PC to '-' (dashes).
Call COD to get procedure code.
Calculate elapsed time from start date to dictation date or current date.
Call SET to update DGJCOTO, DGJT4PC.

71f6de36: Add elapsed time to DGJDICTO counter.
Set DGJT2PC to elapsed time with '*'.
